all_potential_hazards.description: A silver hatchback on the left suddenly cuts across into the driver's lane in close proximity without maintaining safe following distance.
An auto-rickshaw is observed following closely in the rear-view mirror while vehicles ahead are maneuvering.
A motorcyclist overtakes from the left blind spot and sharply cuts directly across into the driver's lane ahead.
Approaching a circular intersection (roundabout) with a pedestrian zebra crossing, directional chevron boards, and curved traffic flow.

critical_hazards_mcqs.hazard_description: A silver car abruptly merges directly across your front bumper from the left lane.
critical_hazards_mcqs.mcq: When a vehicle sharply cuts into your lane immediately ahead of you, what is the safest defensive driving action?
options: A) Accelerate and flash high beams to deter the car from merging
B) Swerve immediately into the adjacent right lane to avoid braking
C) Ease off the accelerator, apply gentle braking, and re-establish a safe 3-second following distance
D) Honk continuously and tailgate the vehicle to signal their violation
critical_hazards_mcqs.correct_answer: C) Ease off the accelerator, apply gentle braking, and re-establish a safe 3-second following distance
critical_hazards_mcqs.safe_action_explanation: Under the Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations, 2017, drivers must maintain a safe distance from the vehicle ahead. When another driver cuts in abruptly, easing off the accelerator and applying gradual braking helps avoid a collision without risking a rear-end collision from traffic behind.

critical_hazards_mcqs.hazard_description: A motorcyclist undertakes on the left and swerves abruptly into your immediate path.
critical_hazards_mcqs.mcq: A two-wheeler overtakes aggressively from your left blind spot and cuts directly ahead into your lane. What should you do?
options: A) Maintain current speed and maintain lane position since the two-wheeler is in violation
B) Check mirrors, gently decelerate, cover the brake pedal, and allow the rider ample safety buffer
C) Veer sharply toward the median divider to give the rider clearance
D) Speed up to pass the two-wheeler before it stabilizes in the lane
critical_hazards_mcqs.correct_answer: B) Check mirrors, gently decelerate, cover the brake pedal, and allow the rider ample safety buffer
critical_hazards_mcqs.safe_action_explanation: Vulnerable road users such as motorcyclists can be unpredictable. When overtaken closely on the left (undertaking), defensive driving dictates checking your rear-view mirror, gently reducing speed, and covering the brake to give them sufficient stopping buffer in compliance with safe driving practices under Indian road regulations.

critical_hazards_mcqs.hazard_description: Approaching a marked roundabout with a pedestrian zebra crossing and sharp curve.
critical_hazards_mcqs.mcq: As you approach this multi-lane roundabout and marked pedestrian crossing, what is the correct driving procedure?
options: A) Maintain cruising speed and enter forcefully to claim right of way over vehicles already in the circle
B) Reduce speed, check for crossing pedestrians, and give way to traffic already circulating from your right
C) Switch to the outermost left shoulder to bypass the roundabout queue
D) Continuously honk and accelerate to clear the zebra crossing before other vehicles arrive
critical_hazards_mcqs.correct_answer: B) Reduce speed, check for crossing pedestrians, and give way to traffic already circulating from your right
critical_hazards_mcqs.safe_action_explanation: According to Regulation 14 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations, 2017, drivers approaching a roundabout must slow down and give way to traffic approaching from the right already circulating on the roundabout, and give precedence to pedestrians at pedestrian crossings.
